Welcome! I'm a second-year PhD Candidate in Statistics at the University of Waterloo, working under the supervision of [Prof. Richard Cook](https://www.math.uwaterloo.ca/~rjcook/).
I completed my BMath in 2022 and my MMath in Statistics in 2024, both also at the University of Waterloo.

My research interests include multistate modelling under complex observation schemes as well as two-phase designs for failure time studies.<br><br>
